violation_type.title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §744.307(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization
violation_type.typical_finding: It was determined during the course of the investigation that the parents were not notified immediately following an injury to the head.  The injury required medical attention.  Information needs to be provided as to how the program will notify parents in a timely manner of serious injuries.

finding_variants.text: It was determined during the course of the investigation that the parents were not notified immediately following an injury to the head.  The injury required medical attention.  Information needs to be provided as to how the program will notify parents in a timely manner of serious injuries.

A child fell during outdoor play causing an injury later finding it was a broken arm. An ice pack was applied but the parent was not notified until pick up. The child was told he was fine and later the parent was told the child was fine.
It was determined in an investigation that after a child was injured (fracture) the parents were not notified of the injury until 2.5 hours later when they arrived to pick up the child.
A child fell in care while at the operation resulting in a fracture and the oeprtaion waited three hours before informing the parent.
It was determined during the course of the investigation that the parents were not notified immediately following an injury to the head.  The injury required medical attention.
Based on information obtained during the investigation, the operation failed to notify a parent that their child was injured and required medical treatment.
